description.zh: 查询节点详细信息的深度（层数），当Depth为2时，将会返回该节点及其下一层的所有子节点的信息。
description.en: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to 2, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the next layer is returned.

description.zh: 查询的工作流任务节点的名称。
description.en: The name of the pipeline node.

description.zh: 工作流任务节点ID。如何获取节点ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The ID of the pipeline node. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the node ID.

description.zh:
排序顺序，取值如下，与SortBy一起使用：
- DESC（默认值）：降序排列
- ASC：升序排列
description.en:
The sorting order. This parameter must be used together with the SortBy parameter. Valid values:

*   DESC (default)
*   ASC
The page number. Pages start from page 1.
The number of entries per page.

description.zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见[ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~)。
description.en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

description.zh:
用于排序返回结果的字段，目前支持如下字段：
- Name
- Type
- GmtCreateTime
description.en:
The field used to sort the returned results. The following fields are supported:

*   Name
*   Type
*   GmtCreateTime

description.zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID。
description.en: The ID of the shared pipeline job.

description.zh:
工作流任务节点产物（Artifact）的类型：
- Model：模型
- DataSet：数据集
- Metrics：度量数据
- ModelEvaluation：模型评估结果
description.en:
The output type of the pipeline node.

*   Model
*   DataSet
*   Metrics
*   ModelEvaluation

title.zh: 获取工作流任务节点输出

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-outputs --pipeline-run-id flow-n06dn00000000rfc53 --node-id node-n06dn00000000rfc53 --depth 2 --name myName --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order DESC --type DataSet --token-id 'https://pai.console.aliyun.com/0regionId=cn-hangzhou_workspaceId=102000000_mode=noSidebar#/paiflow/pipeline-runs/flow-6y70000000Token=eyJ0e000000' --region cn-hangzhou
